derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G757 (ἄρχω) (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch");
def: a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture

occurrences.text: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;
Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cesarea to Jerusalem.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
